overall.learningOrder: The new draft carries the article's sequential logic from conventions/Euler angles through aliasing, canonical boundaries, interpolation and axis-angle/rotation vectors. Existing examples are used as observation bridges rather than unsupported internal engine measurements.
overall.continuity: Connections inherit the preceding concrete result: same pose→multiple number sets→intermediate paths→scope of wrap→one axis→rotation amount versus history→composition limits.
overall.paceRisk: The former single first-three-lines beat per scene left later calculations, caveats and questions without actual observation cues. The 106-beat overlay now covers all 250 lines with concept-specific targets and reading tasks.
overall.productionGate: No actual audio speed or mobile readability pass claimed. Initial observation durations must be verified against produced media; null motion durations deliberately avoid compression.

resolvedInCurrentDraft.finding: Euler angles are defined before their later naming and comparison.
1rad now starts with equal radius/arc lengths before π and conversion constants.
